payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: title-route -N <v2-stem> overwrite misses the family when the source file stem collides with the rejected Info title (same-stem source + stem-equal Info title falls back to humanize(-N stem) = "report v2" for identity, matching nothing). Output phase done: alias rewrite gated on real title change with old (vN) suffix preserved; success/dry-run lines report final status/highlights/task state with inline reopen hint, kept-audio parenthetical, and sync: committed short-sha (push-pending text kept); Play link bound on markdown/vault-note renders; finished narration kept via post_listen_error on all routes; -a with new extension publishes at library stem and removes old companion in-transaction; aliases/topics/research carried into marker and live note; clip/create docs corrected. Verified: cargo fmt, clippy gate (-D unused, -D private_interfaces) exit 0, just docs-gen + docs-check pass, cargo test lib 3534 ok, cli 2188 ok (incl. 8 new overwrite tests); 2 capture_related timing flakes fail only under parallel load and pass in isolation (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP noted, tracked by bob-cli-ca).

Harden overwrite transaction: reselect after locked pre-sync (preimage_changed when a later reading appears, a named member vanishes, or bytes change); refuse gitignored/untracked files under touched dirs as dirty_paths; restore only base-tracked paths; reject empty/CurDir/dot intent paths; standalone vault-sync recovers a planted intent; task-move refuses while pending; executor failpoints leave intact old state or verified committed new state. Dropped blanket dead_code allows on mod overwrite and recovery save/load/clear. Documented interrupted overwrite recovery in docs/highlights-ref-sync.md. keep_user_fields=keep unchanged. Verified: 35 overwrite::* lib tests, ignored_paths_under unit, CLI gitignored sidecar dirty_paths, vault-sync recover, task-move refuse; just fmt --check; clippy -D unused; just docs-gen; just docs-check. just check: fmt+clippy green, CLI/integration green; only lib failure is capture_related synthetic_vault_draft_contract_is_under_250ms (855ms vs 500ms) which passed in isolation and is tracked by bob-cli-ca. epic-symbols: none.

payload.entry: FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Reviewed all three child beads and every note. (1) bob-cli-c9.4.1.9.2 #1, title-route -N report__v2 with a same-stem/missing-Info local PDF, is accepted as remaining epic contract work, not a separate task: pdf_target::plan_local_pdf currently derives the fallback identity title from the -N target stem. The repair tale will fix and regress it. (2) bob-cli-c9.4.1.9.2 #2 and bob-cli-c9.4.1.9.3 #1 are the same unrelated capture_related synthetic-vault timing flake; /sase_new_task search, recent-flake sweep, bob-cli-ca read, and active-epic sweep completed. Added one corroborating +1 to existing ready small flake bob-cli-ca with both proposing bead IDs and the 855 ms observation. No duplicate task created; bob-cli-bo remains closed because it fixed the distinct CLI timing gate. No other PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes were present; no proposals discarded without disposition.

LAND REVIEW at 66f9d67f: Audited all 3 phases and every note, linked plan and binding ancestor contracts, and commits 3e9da7cc/43f8aff5/66f9d67f. Reviewed live selection/preflight, output/user-field/audio plumbing, executor, recovery, shared git helpers, vault-sync and rename integrations plus tests. keep_user_fields=keep is implemented in prepare/stamping/article paths; keep_created and legacy_force inherited choices remain unchanged. Fetched origin/master: no base-branch drift. The sole outside commit since the first epic commit is 17f3881c (root:true project grouping), reviewed in pomodoro_homes/facts.rs, resolve.rs and stats/homes.rs; it does not consume or duplicate overwrite and needs no integration change. Current epic-symbols is empty; justfile has no symvision recipe. 61 existing CLI overwrite_ tests pass. A temporary filename-only probe of overwrite_title_change_keeps_old_version_suffix failed with nothing to overwrite for report.pdf plus -N report__v2; source restored after probe. Remaining work prevents closing: (a) source PDF identity incorrectly depends on -N when Info title is absent/rejected; (b) collection final recheck and marker extraction occur after narration but before the post_listen_error guard, so those failures discard completed audio; analogous marker extraction is unguarded in local/article finish paths; (c) dead selector wrappers select_url_member/select_stem_member survive under new allow(dead_code) annotations, contrary to selection-phase delete-or-wire requirement; (d) failpoint fixture has no authored prose, sidecar, replacement audio, title/status/task change, so several apply checkpoints test a no-op and do not prove rollback of those actual mutations. A medium tale will repair only these gaps and perform nested closeout in the same turn as the final code, without waiting for its own commit or CI.

ADDITIONAL REPRO: A temporary probe of tests/cli/highlights/create.rs::highlights_create_collection_overwrites_exact_set_with_listen made the fake listener write the MP3 successfully, log its path, and remove the selected root note using FAKE_LISTEN_REMOVE. The post-listen recheck exited 2 (-N tokio_internals is not a reading ...); stdout had no kept: line and the produced audio no longer existed. The assertion of preserved audio failed. This confirms the collection preservation gap, not just a code-inspection concern. The diagnostic source was restored. The medium repair tale has concrete regressions, actual-write failpoint proof, and complete same-turn closeout through bob-cli-c9.4.1.9 -> bob-cli-c9.4.1 -> phase bob-cli-c9.4, stopping before outer epic bob-cli-c9.
